description: Labeled retrieval questions for the BM25 / dense / hybrid ablation. A chunk is relevant when it contains the fact (alternatives separated by ' || '). 'lexical' questions reuse the corpus's own terms (form numbers, figures, names); 'paraphrase' questions deliberately avoid them. None of these are the app's preset prompts.

questions.fact: Arrival delay of 9 hours or more: CAD $1,000

questions.fact: Small carriers pay CAD $125

questions.query: EU261 compensation for a flight over 3,500 km
questions.fact: Distance over 3,500 km, extra-EU: EUR 600
